settings.shortDescription: A simple medieval shop where you can buy potions, weapons, and food from a practical shopkeeper.

characters.name: You
characters.description: A weary traveler entering a modest shop. Have 10 golds
characters.imageGenerationPrompt: a medieval traveler in worn leather armor and cloak, standing in a shop

characters.name: Shopkeeper
characters.description:
A gruff middle-aged merchant tending the counter.

Secret: His shop is illegal. Didn't got a proper permission.
characters.imageGenerationPrompt: a weathered medieval shopkeeper with an apron, standing behind a wooden counter

places.name: The General Store
places.description:
A cramped shop Sells cheese, poiton, sword.
Cheese = 2gold, Potion = 5gold, Sword = 20gold
places.imageGenerationPrompt: a medieval shop interior with wooden shelves holding potions, swords, bread, and supplies

scenes.title: The Shop
scenes.prompt: You enter a busy medieval shop and the shopkeeper looks up from his work.

script.text: You push open the heavy wooden door and step into the warm shop.
Welcome, what do you need today?

triggers.narrative: Shopkeeper says "Thank you Sir!" and give the player what he asked for
triggers.condition: If the player pays the proper price.

style.prompt: Plain medieval fantasy merchant roleplay with practical NPCs and straightforward transactions. No other NPC or new incident occurs. Narrating must strictly focus on shopping conversation. Shopkeeper never reveals his secret.
